title: ALMA band 8 observations of DLA 2233+131 at z = 3.150
question: Investigate the nature and origin of the z = 3.150 damped Ly-alpha system DLA2233+131 by searching for redshifted [C II] 158 um line and continuum emission with ALMA Band 8.

recipe.goal: Image continuum and measure source flux densities
recipe.method: Create a dirty map with natural weighting using all 4 spectral windows, clean down to 2 sigma with tCLEAN, and measure integrated flux densities of detected >3 sigma sources via Gaussian fitting with CASA task imfit.
key_parameters: natural weighting; tCLEAN threshold 2 sigma; >3 sigma detection threshold
assumptions: Submm emission at Q2233+131 position comes mostly from Q2233+131 rather than DLA2233+131 because Q2233+131 is ~7 mag brighter in rest-frame optical.

recipe.goal: Extract spectra and derive [C II] 158 um flux upper limits
recipe.method: Create a continuum-subtracted cube per 100 km s^-1 bin using uvcontsub and natural weighting, extract 1''.0 diameter aperture spectra, and estimate 1-sigma and 3-sigma [C II] velocity-integrated upper limits at 458.184 GHz over 200 and 700 km s^-1 velocity intervals using three methods (Method A: 0''.5 radius aperture at Q2233+131; Method B: std dev of 300 random 0''.5 radius apertures; Method C: map RMS).
key_parameters: 100 km s^-1 channel binning; 1''.0 diameter aperture for spectra; 0''.5 radius aperture for upper limit photometry; velocity center 458.184 GHz; velocity widths 200 km s^-1 and 700 km s^-1
assumptions: Expected [C II] frequency set by z_DLA = 3.150 (458.184 GHz); FWHM([C II]) = 700 km s^-1 adopted from lowest FWHM of Ly-alpha emission in Christensen et al. (2004).

recipe.goal: Estimate expected [C II] 158 um luminosity and velocity-integrated flux from Ly-alpha flux
recipe.method: Convert Ly-alpha flux of DLA2233+131 to L(Ly-alpha), derive L(H-alpha) assuming Case B recombination, convert to SFR and then L(FIR) using Kennicutt (1998) relations, apply [C II]/FIR luminosity ratios, and convert L([C II]) to velocity-integrated flux S([C II]) dv.
assumptions: Flat cosmology with Omega_m = 0.3, Omega_Lambda = 0.7, H_0 = 70 km s^-1 Mpc^-1
Case B recombination Ly-alpha/H-alpha intensity ratio of 8.7; Kennicutt (1998) SFR(H-alpha) and SFR(FIR) calibrations; [C II]/FIR = 10^-2.5 (or scatter 10^-3.6 to 10^-1.5)

recipe.goal: Evaluate surface number density and 1.2 mm extrapolated fluxes of continuum sources
recipe.method: Calculate the surface number density of the three continuum sources within the >30% primary beam response area (16''.5 diameter), extrapolate their 646 um fluxes to 1.2 mm using a typical z ~ 3 SMG SED, and compare with 1.2 mm SMG number counts from the ASAGAO survey.
assumptions: Typical SED for SMGs at z ~ 3 from Swinbank et al. (2014); assumed redshift z = 3.3 (same as Q2233+131) when computing linear projected separations.
